name: Mrs. Barr
role: Wife of B. Barr; offered the teaching post
mentions: …ding us the minutes of the board meeting. We learn, however, that the position of teacher was offered to Mrs. Barr, who was obliged to refuse on account of a trip east, and that it was decided to hold the school for a time, at least, at the cantonment.
Mr. and Mrs. Barr started for Missouri, Sunday. Mr. Barr will continue on to Texas.
